t: Trump Believes Zelensky Does Not Want, Never Wanted Settlement in Ukraine
d: US President Donald Trump believes that Vladimir Zelensky does not want, and perhaps never wanted, an end to the conflict in Ukraine.

t: Turkiye Closely Coordinating With Russia on Black Sea Security - Source
d: Turkiye closely coordinates with Russia on security of navigation in the Black Sea amid persisting threats to civil sea traffic and regional trade, a source in the Turkish government told Sputnik.

t: Iran Grateful to Russia for Principled Position on Recent Events in Country - Pezeshkian
d: Iran is grateful to Russian President Vladimir Putin and the Russian people for their principled position on recent events in the country, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Monday.
